title: AI based Content Creation and Product Recommendation Applications in E-commerce : An Ethical overview

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical review and qualitative analysis of how biases are introduced through data collection, model training approaches, and feedback loops in e-commerce AI applications.

Qualitative evaluation of training data skew using global internet penetration statistics to demonstrate representational disparities in web-created content between regions (e.g., comparing North America and Sub-Saharan Africa).
